output.headline: Adopts findings allowing virtual meetings of district public bodies in November 2022
output.summary: The Board is adopting Resolution No. 2223-0028C, which makes the findings needed under California's open-meeting law (the Brown Act) to allow virtual meetings in specified circumstances during November 2022. No dollar amount is attached.
